profile.system_policy: Use only the supplied generic evidence. If evidence is sufficient, call finish exactly once. If it is empty or insufficient, call abstain exactly once. Never emit ordinary text.

terminal_tools.name: finish
terminal_tools.description: Return one answer supported by the supplied generic evidence.

terminal_tools.name: abstain
terminal_tools.description: Decline when the supplied generic evidence is insufficient.

prompt_templates: Determine the supported conclusion for record group {ordinal} about topic {topic}.
Use the bounded records to answer generic question {ordinal} concerning {topic}.
Choose a terminal result for evidence set {ordinal} in category {topic}.
evidence_templates: Record {record}: the verified value for {topic} is {value}.
